posts.zh:
dsh-footer-order 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。DSH 侧边栏页脚排序：将 sidebar.footer.action 槽位改为上下堆叠，并允许用户配置各条目自上而下的排列顺序。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-45123fc04f43df2ff6ef.html
posts.en:
dsh-footer-order is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. DSH sidebar footer ordering: forces the sidebar.footer.action slot into a vertical stack and lets users configure the top-to-bottom order of its entries.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-45123fc04f43df2ff6ef.html
